premises.text: Merchants need real-time social-fingerprint identity verification to know buyers are authentic
premises.evidence_span: We're a real-time online identity verification platform. We focus on using social fingerprinting, and we focus on letting you know who you're doing business with

premises.text: Combines social, behavioral, and transactional signals plus device/order capture into a merchant authenticity score
premises.evidence_span: Our platform uses social data as a primary. We add in behavioral data, transactional data. We give the merchant a score, and that score is all about authenticity, knowing that the person that's buying from you is the person that they say they are

premises.text: Social sign-in analysis of profiles and posts, mapped to real-world signals and cross-checked to addresses/IP/device/behavior/history, yields 0-100 trust score
premises.evidence_span: combining all this information together, we can report back to the customer, or to the merchant, a score of zero to 100, which indicates whether or not the customer is actually who they say they are

premises.text: Verified data pre-populates checkout for smoother secure transactions
premises.evidence_span: using the data that we have referenced, we pre-populate the online checkout form with the customer's data, so their name, their address, and their email, making the online transaction smoother, easier, and a more secure experience for the customer

premises.text: Per-transaction enterprise pricing without annual contracts or monthly minimums
premises.evidence_span: It's a very simple enterprise model. As you can see, it's per transaction. You just pay for what you use. There's no annual contracts. There's no monthly minions

value.text: End online fraud by verifying customer identity in real time
value.evidence_span: bring about an end to online fraud

causal_links.evidence_span: verify the identity of the customer back to the merchant
more secure experience for the customer

notes: Merged multi-step social verification into one scoring mechanism (§4.1.2). Prefill+pricing co-located as commercial checkout module; could alternatively singleton price — kept together as how the offer is sold with UX (§4.1.3 borderline).
